headline: Advanced nine new and revised bylaws toward full consent; made technical edits to Policy 1110.2 and heard 2025-26 assessment results.
summary: Staff presented 2025-26 assessment results, and members asked questions and commented. Members reviewed nine new and revised bylaws, which will move forward for full consent.
decisions: Referred Bylaw 9222 - Removal of Board Officers to the full board for consent.
Referred Bylaw 9312 - Board Bylaws to the full board for consent.
Referred Bylaw 9313 - Formulation, Adoption, Amendment of Administrative Regulations to the full board for consent.
Referred Bylaw 9325.1 - Quorum and Voting Procedures to the full board for consent.
Referred Bylaw 9325.5 - Request for Information by Board Members to the full board for consent.
Referred Bylaw 9327.1 - Board Member Use of Internet Social Networks to the full board for consent.
Referred proposed revisions to Bylaw 9311 - Board Policies to the full board for consent.
Referred proposed revisions to Bylaw 9326 - Minutes to the full board for consent.
Referred proposed revisions to Bylaw 9327 - Electronic Mail Communications to the full board for consent.
Technical edits to Policy 1110.2 - Parent Portal Acceptable Use and Safety will be made to the Policy.
